description: 从官方实际目录指向组件发起一次公开请求，收全原表和字段，不重试。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_dr007_official_history_catalog_probe_v1'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
log=json.loads((OUT/'request_ledger.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(log)==1 and log[0]['status']=='RECEIVED_PUBLIC_CATALOG'
url='https://www.chinamoney.com.cn/r/cms/chinese/chinamoney/html/currency/monthly-pledged-repo.html'
cat=BeautifulSoup((OUT/'raw_01_官方成交概览.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'html.parser')
assert cat.find(attrs={'data-url':'/r/cms/chinese/chinamoney/html/currency/monthly-pledged-repo.html'}),'必须由实际官方目录定位组件'
rec={'request_id':2,'requested_at':now(),'method':'GET','url':url,'credential_used':False,'retry':0,'purpose':'实际目录的质押式回购月报组件，核对DR/R总体、频率和统计量'}
raw=b''
try:
 with requests.get(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'text/html,application/xhtml+xml'},timeout=(10,25),stream=True) as response:
  rec.update(http_status=response.status_code,final_url=response.url,content_type=response.headers.get('Content-Type'),response_date_header=response.headers.get('Date'))
  for chunk in response.iter_content(65536):
   raw+=chunk
   if len(raw)+sum(r.get('bytes',0) for r in log)>4*1024*1024:raise RuntimeError('公开对象总量超过4MiB')
 rec.update(received_at=now(),bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
 (OUT/'raw_02_质押式回购月报组件.html').write_bytes(raw)
 rec['raw_path']=(OUT/'raw_02_质押式回购月报组件.html').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
 rec['status']='RECEIVED_MONTHLY_COMPONENT' if rec['http_status']==200 else 'FAILED_HTTP_NO_RETRY'
except Exception as e:rec.update(received_at=now(),bytes=len(raw),status='FAILED_REQUEST_NO_RETRY',exception_class=type(e).__name__,public_error=str(e))
log.append(rec)
(OUT/'request_ledger.json').write_text(json.dumps(log,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False))
if rec['status']=='RECEIVED_MONTHLY_COMPONENT':
 text=raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace');soup=BeautifulSoup(text,'html.parser')
 tables=[]
 for idx,t in enumerate(soup.find_all('table')):
  rows=[[c.get_text(' ',strip=True) for c in r.find_all(['th','td'])] for r in t.find_all('tr')]
  tables.append({'table_index':idx,'rows':rows})
 (OUT/'月报静态表_所有原行.json').write_text(json.dumps(tables,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 print('月报静态表',json.dumps(tables,ensure_ascii=False)[:5000])
 lines=text.splitlines()
 for i,line in enumerate(lines):
  if any(x in line for x in ['DR','R007','instrmnt','trdVol','reportMonth','reportDate','startDate','endDate','url:','data-name','月报','日期','统计','注：','机构']):
   print(str(i+1)+':'+line[:800])
